title: Morning Time Budget
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Calculate the minutes, hours, and school days a compressed academic morning frees, and the speedup it requires, then explore the trade-off with sliders.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the minutes freed per day, the hours freed per year, and the equivalent school days freed by a compressed academic morning, and the speedup it requires, correctly answering three of three questions.
prerequisites: Academic morning, compressed academic morning, reduced direct instruction, and freed-up school time, from the section "The Compressed Academic Morning" in Chapter 11

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Calculate and commit three answers, then explore with sliders
keyQuestions: How long is the compressed morning?
How much faster must students learn to cover the same material?
commonMisconceptions: The time freed is the same whatever the morning contains
A compressed morning needs no faster learning per minute
assessmentOpportunities: Settling 10, explanation 50, practice 90. How many minutes are freed per day?
For the same settings and 180 days, how many hours are freed per year?
Settling 10, explanation 70, practice 110, 180 days, 6.5-hour day. How many school days are freed?
What speedup does a 190-minute morning require?

controls.name: Your answer and Check
controls.description: type a number and press Check. Two tries per question; only the first counts.

controls.name: Next question
controls.description: moves to the next question after feedback. On the last question it reads Unlock the sliders.

controls.name: Five sliders
controls.description: settling and wrap-up (0 to 50 min), explanation (0 to 100 min), practice (0 to 150 min), school days per year (150 to 200), and length of school day (6 to 7 hours). They unlock after the three questions.

controls.name: Reset sliders
controls.description: returns the sliders to 10, 50, and 90 minutes, 180 days, and 6.5 hours.
